seoDescription: SENTINEL: a software-defined autonomous mission vehicle with FPGA-native deterministic edge compute, formal safety and a HIL digital twin.

sections.heading: SENTINEL
sections.body:
FPGA-native deterministic edge compute for a modular autonomous ground platform. Sensors, fusion, IMM-UKF prediction and vehicle control run on dedicated hardware rather than behind an operating-system scheduler, so the critical path has bounded, scheduler-free latency.

The weapon and fire-control chain is one isolated mission payload, not the centerpiece. A formal nav→fire isolation proof enforces the platform↔payload boundary.

images.alt: SENTINEL — pixel interceptor clearing a wave

sections.body: Human-on-the-loop for weapon release. Navigation is autonomous; fire authority never is.

items.label: RTL
items.detail: cores with measured Vivado OOC STA at 200 MHz. 9/9 board bitstreams built.

items.label: SAFETY
items.detail: ROE fire interlock formally proven unbounded (k-induction, sby + z3).

items.label: AUTONOMY
items.detail: waypoints on real Nav2 + slam_toolbox, mission BT, obstacle replan.

items.label: V&V
items.detail: automated gates green, each with a proven fail-path.

sections.heading: THE CRITICAL PATH
sections.body: FPGA-deterministic critical path plus a supervisory SoC. Mission planning, operator UX and non-deterministic inference run on the SoC; detect → track → lead → aim runs on fabric.

items.label: SENTINEL
items.value: SENSORS ▶ FPGA AI ▶ HW FUSION ▶ *IMM-UKF* ▶ MISSION PLAN ▶ VEHICLE CTRL ▶ DRIVE-BY-WIRE

sections.heading: INTERIM · SWAP SLOT
sections.body:
Full UKF predict + update in one entity. 1-D constant-acceleration model, state [p, v, a], H = I, Q16.16 throughout. One shared matmul, time-multiplexed.

Part xczu7ev-ffvc1156-2-e · OOC · dt = 0.1 s · R = 0.01·I

sections.heading: IMM-FAMILY · 2 MODELS
sections.body:
CV (cruise) and CA (maneuver) fixed-gain filters run on the same stream. The bank picks the model with the smaller EWMA innovation, with hysteresis.

Hard switch, not full IMM. Markov mixing + soft blending is the next increment.

sections.body: RTL vs bit-exact twin: 0.0000 on every trajectory

sections.heading: FIG 2 · det(S) PER STEP · CT 6G
sections.body:
┆ DET_FLOOR = 256 · below it matinv returns Sinv = 0

After one measurement P converges toward R. det(S) ≈ 0.02³ lands at ~1 LSB, the singular guard trips, and the gain goes to zero. From step 1 the filter dead-reckons: ct_6g velocity freezes at 40.03 m/s while truth swings to 124 m/s.

sections.heading: FIG 3 · ACCEPTANCE GATE · gain_active
sections.body: The band was one-sided until a mutation test showed a wire scoring 1.0. Accuracy is now gated relative to float64 (1.5× margin, 0.1 m floor).

sections.heading: Not adequate for the fire-control envelope. 214 m RMSE, 336 m peak at 6 g.
sections.body: CV passes for the wrong reason: the filter coasts on an exact model, it is not filtering. H = I flatters it; a position-only sensor would diverge faster.

items.label: Conditioning: wider fraction, square-root / UD covariance, or normalised innovation.
Expressiveness: turning models in the IMM bank to close the 12.6 m single-model residual.
Range: det(S) overflows Q16.16 once P_ii exceeds ~32 (adversarial finding F1).

sections.heading: · NINE RECORDED TRAJECTORIES
sections.body: Step through nine recorded trajectories (birds, a car, three F1 laps, an airplane, a missile, a pedestrian) and compare the IMM filter's estimate and one-step prediction against ground truth, with live tracking error, mode probabilities and RF classification. A replay of stored filter output, not a live tracker.

sections.heading: PHYSICAL PLATFORM
sections.body: Mixed, progressive targets: a Stage-1 pendulum first, then a C-UAS drone tracked on the move.

sections.heading: 3-TIER DIGITAL TWIN
sections.body: Tier A cocotb↔GHDL HIL, Tier B MATLAB/Simulink physics, Tier C ROS 2 / Gazebo. Enriched physics twin cross-validated.

images.alt: Pixel sky battle — the twinned world

sections.heading: ISOLATED EFFECTOR
sections.body: Laser designator first, ballistic later. Aim / ROE / interlock chain only; no terminal-effect modelling.

sections.heading: ADVERSARIAL AGENTS
sections.body: Pursuit and protection agents trained in the twin, each adapting to the other's strategy before transfer to HIL.

sections.heading: LEVEL MAP · 9 MILESTONES
sections.body: Physical bench (M5) → rolling chassis (M6) → closed-loop autonomy on the real UGV (M7) are locked until the board lands. Bring-up runbook and bitstreams are staged.

items.label: No "pure FPGA end-to-end" claim. FPGA critical path + supervisory SoC.
Vendor perf/W figures are reported, not proven. The claim is bounded latency.
Per-core timing MET ≠ system-integration MET. Integration TRL is low.
